about: Client one-frame request to ls::SoundOcclusionSystem carrying the new sound-occlusion quality option; copied into ls::SoundOcclusionSettingsComponent. Never seen alive.

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x1E61E90 (AllocRaw 4) writes 2, no destructor; Toolkit constructor GameEngine.dll+0x68E780 writes 2 too. ls::SoundOcclusionSystem::ProcessSettingsChanges (GameEngine.dll+0x8C4ED0, first query, stride 4) copies the dword into SoundOcclusionSettingsComponent+0x260 (SE: unknown dword, live always 2). The graphics option SE calls SoundOcclusionQuality (Misc.h, int) is the obvious source.
